claim_citation.quote: After evading a volcanic eruption, John arrogantly blames Manhunter for holding him back, restraining him in a construct bubble.

candidates.summary: A temporary restraint construct: John traps Martian Manhunter inside a construct bubble during the Xanshi disaster sequence. This is an assisted/defensive use of the ring, not a sentient construct.
candidates.title: Construct bubble used to hold Martian Manhunter
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John forms a green bubble around Martian Manhunter to keep him from interfering while John approaches the yellow bomb.

claim_citation.quote: John Stewart observes the varied creatures of Oa, describing his relationship to them and their quirks. He has created a road linking each of the Mosaic's cities, and protects the planet's citizens from themselves and each other.

candidates.summary: A large-scale infrastructure construct: John makes a road connecting the cities of the Mosaic world. This is a stable, functional construct, but not autonomous.
candidates.title: Road linking the Mosaic cities
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John lays down a continuous road across Oa/Mosaic to connect the transplanted city-communities.

claim_citation.quote: In despair, he creates a construct of his dead little sister, Ellie, to calm his mother.

candidates.summary: The most insane construct in the set: John creates a realistic dead-sister construct to comfort his dementia-stricken mother. This is a temporary, emotionally targeted construct that later becomes an ongoing autonomous presence in the run.
candidates.title: Dead-sister construct Ellie
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John manifests Ellie as a lifelike construct and presents her to his mother as a comforting companion.
